SD03-015.name: Brave Draw
SD03-015.effect:
[Main]
Draw two cards. Then, reveal three cards from your decktop, and add a Brave card among them to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the decktop in any order.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit +2000 BP.

SD03-017.name: Blue Splash
SD03-017.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit. Or, return a Nexus card from your Trash to the Hand.

SD03-016.name: Sagitta Flame
SD03-016.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. Or, destroy an opposing Nexus.

SD03-007.name: The BattleDragon Elginius
SD03-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol and color are also treated as Red.

SD03-010.name: The CannonDragon Bal-Gunner
SD03-010.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 4 or more]

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Draw a card, and destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit.

SD03-011.name: The CrustDragon Groun-Giras
SD03-011.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 3 or more]

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

[During Brave] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus

SD03-012.name: The FangEmperor Cerbelord
SD03-012.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 5 or more]

[When Braved] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, by discarding five cards from your decktop, refresh this Spirit.

SD03-013.name: The Fire Paradise
SD03-013.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
Give every Brave card in your Hand an extra [Red Core] reduction symbol.

[LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Increase the number of cards you draw by +1.

SD03-004.name: The HornBeast Gulnearl
SD03-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Astral Dragon" family Spirit card, or an "Astral Dragon" family Brave card to the Hand. Return the remaining cards to the deckbottom in any order.

SD03-008.name: The MasterCarpenter Mccoy
SD03-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a number of cores equal to this Spirit's LV from the Void to a Nexus you control.

SD03-014.name: The Olymspia Stadium
SD03-014.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Either Main Step)
Spirits can't be summoned via Spirit/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When opposing non-braved Spirit would attack, unless the opponent sends a core from their Reserve to the Trash, it can't attack.

SD03-009.name: The StarMonster Sea-Serpendar
SD03-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] [Assault: 1] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to once per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
While you control any Brave Spirit, Cost 4 or less Spirits can't attack.

SD03-006.name: The SunDragon Sieg-Apollodragon
SD03-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing refreshed Spirit.

[When Braved] [LV3] (When Brave Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 9000 BP or less Spirit.

SD03-002.name: The SwordDinoman Stegorus
SD03-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While you control two or fewer Spirits, treat this Spirit as being at LV3.
